lessons.title: Planting trees
lessons.kind: 对话 · 刘老师与同学们讨论植树活动

lines.text: Good morning, everyone! Who is on weather duty today?
It’s me! Today is Monday, March 1. The temperature will reach 15°C by noon and drop to 2°C at night. Overall, it will be a warm, cloudy day.
Well done, Wang Mei. The days are getting longer, and spring is coming. We have a school project on March 12. Can you guess what it is?
Is it tree planting?
Good guess. Do you know how to plant trees?
Yes. I learned to plant trees when I visited my uncle last spring. It was so much fun.
Could you tell us the steps for planting trees?
Sure. First, dig a large hole. Then, place the seedling inside the hole, and cover its roots with soil. Finally, press down the soil. Oh, don’t forget to water the tree.
Excellent, Li Ming. Why do people plant trees? Do you have any ideas?
Trees help protect the soil from rainfall.
Trees prevent dust from spreading.
Good points. Planting trees is also a wonderful way to learn more about nature. I believe you will have a great time with this project.

lessons.title: It's getting warmer!
lessons.kind: 书信 · 王梅写给詹妮的电子邮件

lines.text: Dear Jenny, Today is March 6. Jingzhe falls on this day this year.
Do you know what Jingzhe is?
It is one of China’s 24 solar terms, and it means “awakening of insects”.
The spring thunder wakes insects up from their sleep.
Then nature begins to come back to life.
Spring is in the air. This morning, the temperature was 10°C in my city.
It reached 15°C this afternoon. It was quite warm. I don’t need my heavy winter coat or boots now!
On my way to school, I saw some winter jasmine blossoming.
People believe the blossom of this flower always tells the coming of spring, so we call winter jasmine “the welcoming-spring flower”.
I like spring. It is the best season for going out. We are going to be more active, like insects!
We will form a music band. There is going to be a basketball game next week. My class is also planning a field trip. We will plant trees. I can’t wait!
What’s the weather like in Canada? What type of classic spring activities do you do?
Wang Mei

lessons.title: The Spring City
lessons.kind: 叙述 · 第一人称介绍家乡昆明（春城）

lines.text: When we talk about spring, we think of a season of warm weather and fresh air.
We also think of new life, green plants, and budding trees all around us.
Spring is short in many places around the world.
But in my hometown, it feels like spring nearly all year round.
The weather here is neither too hot nor too cold.
The average temperature in winter is 15°C. In summer, the average temperature is 24°C.
While the sun is shining, the temperature remains pleasant.
The city gets about 2,250 hours of sunshine and about 1,000 millimetres of rain every year.
Because the weather is spring-like, you can find hundreds of beautiful flowers and trees all year round.
There are many famous scenic spots in my hometown.
The Stone Forest is a must-see for tourists from home and abroad.
There are many special rocks that look like tall stone trees.
The Dianchi Lake is the biggest in Yunnan Province.
You can enjoy the beauty of the area and go boating or take a walk by the water.
Can you guess the name of my hometown? Yes, it’s Kunming — the Spring City.
Welcome to my hometown.
When you visit, you will feel our warmth and friendliness, just like spring!

lessons.title: Stories about spring
lessons.kind: 说明+书信 · 土拨鼠日文化小贴士与詹妮的回信

lines.text: Groundhog Day is on February 2. On that day, a small animal called groundhog comes out of its hole in the ground.
Dear Wang Mei, It isn’t snowing today, but there is still snow on the grass.
In Edmonton, the spring weather is a little wild.
It can be cold and snowy or warm and sunny.
The temperature can be as low as -15°C, but it can also reach 15°C.
We probably won’t see any flowers until May or June!
After school today, we had so much fun playing outside.
We played “snow” soccer, but we had to wear jackets, jeans, and boots to stay warm.
When it gets warmer, we can play in our shorts and T-shirts.
I like spring because there are lots of activities to do, like cycling, having picnics, and hiking.
I like the Chinese name for winter jasmine. It’s interesting.
Here, we have Groundhog Day on February 2 for the coming of spring.
Do you know what happens on that day?
Another fun part of spring is going to the sugar bush, a big tree farm in the countryside.
We make maple syrup.
We eat lots of tasty breakfast foods — all with maple syrup on them!
I love spring activities.
Talk to you soon!
Jenny

lessons.title: Jeremy's observation diary
lessons.kind: 日记 · 杰里米的豌豆生长观察日记

lines.text: In the life skills class last week, we learned about agriculture and plant biology.
The teacher gave us some seeds so we could observe the growing process of a plant.
I picked some pea seeds and planted them in a small pot. I watered them every day.
I hope my peas grow quickly!
Here are some of my observations on the peas’ growth:
Date: March 3 Weather conditions: sunny, temperature around 18°C
Observations: The pea seeds grew into buds. They look like the English letter “Y”.
My peas are growing quickly!
Date: April 3 Weather conditions: rainy, temperature around 22°C
Observations: The pea flowers are in full bloom. Some are pink and some are purple.
When the pea plants grow taller, I will give them a shelf to climb on.
Date: March 30 Weather conditions: cloudy, temperature around 19°C
Observations: Now, there are long, thin stems and some leaves.
At the top of the stems are little flower buds!
I put the pot in the yard. There, they can get some sunshine.

lessons.title: The 24 solar terms
lessons.kind: 说明文 · 春季六个节气介绍

lines.text: The 24 solar terms reflect the wisdom of our ancestors.
They help us understand how nature changes throughout the year.
Our ancestors observed nature and created the Chinese lunar calendar to guide farming and daily life.
There are several solar terms for the spring season.
They tell us about the coming of this beautiful season.
Start of Spring
It usually falls around February 4 or 5 and marks the beginning of spring.
The weather starts to get warmer and we can see new plants grow and animals become active after a long winter.
Rain Water
It arrives around February 19 or 20. It reminds us of the increase in rainfall as the weather gets warmer.
Jingzhe (Awakening of Insects)
It usually takes place around March 5 or 6.
Jingzhe tells us that insects are coming out of hibernation.
We might hear more birds singing and see butterflies and bees buzzing around.
Spring Equinox
It comes around March 20 or 21, when the length of the day is nearly equal to that of the night.
Qingming (Clear and Bright)
It usually falls around April 4 or 5. Qingming is a time when people honour their ancestors. It’s also a time to enjoy outdoor activities and the beauty of spring.
Grain Rain
It occurs around April 19 or 20. Farmers sow seeds during this time, and the rain nourishes the soil to make sure the farmers have a good harvest in the future.
These solar terms teach us how to follow the seasons and make the best of them.
They show us the relationship between humans and nature and call upon us to respect the world around us.
